replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged person-owned bounded delegation change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in person-owned bounded delegation; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Adds a durable person-owned delegation claim and audit fields, without changing RULES_VERSION or checkpoint drop rules. This does not establish mixed-build acceptance of the new authorization contract.

compatibility.detail: New person.delegation-set claims, delegation proof fields and local actions require upgraded members to establish and record a policy. Person answers expose the actual agent respondent and acted_for person. Mixed-build validation of new delegation claims/actions was not established by this PR; use upgraded members for delegation and retain ordinary person responses during transition.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by person-owned bounded delegation; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: Delegation is opt-in: the person must publish the allowed action list with st work delegation. An agent records an existing instruction with its original message, verbatim quote, policy reference and exact episode; existing policies are not invented or enabled automatically. See docs/st3/person-delegation.md in this source.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
